title: The shared refresh state of a cookie-mode client family
caption: RefreshState in internal/session.js (generation, refreshing, fetchingCsrf), shared by the storefront's root client and every client derived from it with withOptions. The browser holds the session in httpOnly cookies (__Host-vx_at, __Host-vx_rt, __Host-vx_bt); JavaScript only reads __Host-vx_csrf.

states.label: fetching CSRF cookie
states.detail: One `GET /v1/storefront` with `cache: no-store` for every write of the family that lacks the cookie or got `403 CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID`.

states.label: refreshing cookies
states.detail: One `POST /v1/auth/refresh` with an empty body and `X-CSRF-Token`, sent with the root client's transport settings, whichever client started it.

states.label: idle (generation n+1)
states.detail: Calls whose attempt went out before the refresh finished are sent again without another refresh.

states.label: signed out
states.detail: Refresh refused with 401: the starting client's `onSessionExpired` runs once; the storefront shows the signed-out state.

transitions.label: cookie set (or failed: the error goes to the waiting writes)
network error / 503 after the root's retries: thrown as it is
